fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Aspect ratio of the edited image. Standard auto uses the nearest supported ratio of the first reference.

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the generated image: 1k, 1.5k, or 2k.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The format of the generated image.

fields.name: quality
fields.title: Quality
fields.description: Quality level of the edited image. `auto` lets xAI choose; it currently uses `medium` for editing.
